name: xdoubleu-claude-plugins
description: xdoubleu's personal Claude Code plugins: generic skills for the fresh-worktree/ship-PR task flow, session retrospectives, git cleanup, GitHub issue triage, skill placement, and session hygiene (status line + compact-idle hooks).

plugins.name: git-task-flow
plugins.description: Generic fresh-worktree-off-main setup and rebase/push/PR/auto-merge/CI-watch shipping flow for any git+GitHub repo.

plugins.name: session-retro
plugins.description: Analyze the current session's own tool calls and CI runs for concrete inefficiencies, and ship the smallest fix as its own issue/PR when something real turns up.

plugins.name: git-cleanup
plugins.description: Automatically removes local git worktrees and branches for PRs already merged (including squash merges) at the start of every session, plus an on-demand skill for the same cleanup.

plugins.name: github-issue-triage
plugins.description: Config-driven GitHub issue refinement and bulk triage: summaries, labels, priority, project-board status, duplicate merging, and splitting oversized issues into sub-issues.

plugins.name: skill-lifecycle
plugins.description: After a skill is created or substantially edited in any project, decides whether it should stay project-specific or move to/update this marketplace, and keeps project wrapper skills honest about what they delegate.

plugins.name: session-hygiene
plugins.description: Status line (model/effort/context%/rate limits/worktree badge) and the compact-idle hygiene hooks: a sound + systemMessage nudge to /compact when idle with high context usage, and a hard block on new prompts past a context threshold until you do.
